title: HandForge Preset Template Library
description: Curated conversion templates based on platform publisher guidance (Apple Podcasts, YouTube) and common archival / delivery workflows.

templates.name: Podcast AAC 128k
templates.description: Stereo AAC at 128 kbps — Apple Podcasts RSS baseline for 44.1/48 kHz stereo (recommended range 128–256 kbps). Uses .m4a for efficient streaming/seeking.

templates.name: Podcast AAC 160k
templates.description: Stereo AAC at 160 kbps — common high-quality podcast encode within Apple's 128–256 kbps stereo RSS guidance.

templates.name: Podcast MP3 128k
templates.description: Stereo MP3 at 128 kbps for maximum RSS/player compatibility when AAC is not preferred.

templates.name: Voice / Speech MP3 96k
templates.description: Compact speech delivery near Apple's mono MP3 recommended band (96–128 kbps). Suitable for interviews, notes, and narration.

templates.name: Audiobook AAC 64k
templates.description: Small AAC files for spoken-word / audiobook distribution (aligned with Apple mono RSS 64–128 kbps guidance).

templates.name: Music Streaming AAC 256k
templates.description: High-quality lossy music delivery at 256 kbps AAC CBR.

templates.name: Music HiFi MP3 320k
templates.description: Maximum common MP3 CBR bitrate for archival-friendly lossy music sharing.

templates.name: Music Archive FLAC
templates.description: Lossless FLAC for music library archival and CD rips.

templates.name: Archive Master WAV
templates.description: Uncompressed PCM WAV for masters and further editing (Apple accepts WAV/FLAC as source uploads).

templates.name: Extract Audio WAV
templates.description: Pull audio from video into lossless WAV for editing.

templates.name: YouTube 1080p H.264
templates.description: MP4 H.264 ~8 Mbps with AAC stereo ~384 kbps — YouTube SDR 1080p standard-frame-rate upload guidance.

templates.name: YouTube 720p H.264
templates.description: MP4 H.264 ~5 Mbps with AAC stereo — YouTube SDR 720p standard-frame-rate upload guidance.

templates.name: Web Delivery WebM VP9
templates.description: VP9 WebM for web playback with moderate quality CRF-style target.

templates.name: Mobile Compact H.265
templates.description: HEVC smart compression (~7× size reduction) for mobile storage and sharing.

templates.name: Extract Audio MP3 192k
templates.description: Extract soundtrack from video as CBR MP3 192 kbps.
